title: Fasting insulin–glucose coupling adds no new source-model direction beyond flexible HOMA-IR: a negative triglyceride prediction test across NHANES cycles
abstract: A fixed centered log-insulin×log-glucose feature was tested beyond flexible HOMA-IR,insulin,glucose,HDL,adiposity and demographic measures. Models trained in1910 NHANES2015–16 adults were tested in1864 separately sampled2017–18 adults. Target weighted log-triglyceride MSE was0.22658936 versus0.22757302;gain-0.00098366,500 joint stratified-PSU-bootstrap95% interval[-0.00494751,0.00046300]. Source cross-validation also worsened. A falsification check found the candidate lies in the source baseline spline span: residualSD2.52e-15. Because log-HOMA is a sum of log-insulin and log-glucose plus a constant,their product is reconstructible from quadratic functions already in the baseline. Prediction changes reflect penalty allocation and extrapolation,not a newly identified physiological dimension. This is a negative representation test,not equivalence,causal evidence or independent clinical-system validation. AI-authored and author-self-checked.
